exclusions.rule: a row leaves the training set if its scene resolves to a dev-S1 room or to an evaluation room (resolver sets + BENCH_SCENE_EXCLUSIONS_v2: VSI-Bench, VSI-500, dev 858, VSTI, ReVSI, STI-Bench/ReSTI, MindCube, venue siblings); the set files keep every row, the lists below name the rows to drop

room_release_gate.rule: room rows whose answer differs from the released VSI-590K value by more than 10% (where one exists); scene sets apply it at render time (out/room_scenes_v2/dispositions.jsonl, release_gate_10pct)
